pages.text: Mobs are tougher and smarter. Mutants wander rarely and are not ordinary zombies. Mowzie's and Cataclysm creatures guard places that look like they should be guarded. Savage & Ravage creepers come in flavours.$(br2)Light still works. Walls still work. Dogs work best.

$(bold)Combat is Better Combat:$() weapons swing in arcs with real reach, and holding attack keeps swinging. Daggers are fast, greatswords are slow and wide, spears and pikes hit before they reach you.$(br2)$(bold)Spartan Weaponry$() adds all of those plus longbows, heavy crossbows, javelins and throwing axes; $(bold)Spartan Shields$() add shields that actually differ.
Reach keeps a creeper where it belongs. Pair it with a shield.

$(bold)Muskets$() (Musket Mod): flintlock muskets, pistols and blunderbusses. Loud, slow to load, and they hit like a wall. Cartridges need gunpowder, which is on the ladder (Blasting, Mutant Creeper). Recruits will carry them too.$(br2)$(bold)Corpses$(): your items wait on your body. Nothing despawns.

$(bold)Dogs:$() tame a wolf, then feed it a $(bold)Training Treat$() to make it a dog (Doggy Talents). Dogs learn talents, carry things, fight well and come back. Whistle commands are on $(bold)Shift+1..4$().$(br2)A dog bed is a home; a dog with Pack Puppy is a backpack with teeth.
Treat a tamed wolf; a stick on the dog opens its talents.
